title: Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

reading.body:
An AI-generated fake website was deployed in a financial fraud scheme to deceive victims about their investment returns. The system showed false gains on the victim's screen while stolen funds disappeared, creating a false sense of successful trading that built confidence for larger fraudulent transfers. A human check on actual account activity or transaction verification would have revealed the discrepancy between displayed gains and actual fund movements.

The scam exploited the victim's trust through incremental fraud, allowing small legitimate-seeming withdrawals before larger requests were denied. The AI-generated website was one element in a social engineering attack that began with contact via WhatsApp and included impersonation of legitimate financial services. It is not established whether the website used machine learning or other AI techniques beyond generation, or what level of visual sophistication was required to deceive the victim.

reports.title: Georgia couple loses $800K in sophisticated cryptocurrency scam
Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

summary:
A retired Georgia couple lost nearly $800,000 in a cryptocurrency scam that started when a stranger contacted them through WhatsApp. The scammer convinced Jerry Dunaway to invest money using a mobile trading app, gradually building trust by allowing him to make small trades and withdraw funds. Unknown to Jerry, the scammers had created an artificial intelligence-generated fake website that showed false investment gains on his screen while the money actually disappeared.

The couple discovered the fraud when Jerry tried to make a larger withdrawal and could not access his funds. Jerry and Mindy Dunaway are now speaking publicly to warn others about the sophisticated tactics used by these scammers. Gwinnett County police are investigating, though authorities say victims in these cases rarely recover their money. Their children have started a GoFundMe page to help the couple with daily expenses as they work to rebuild their lives.
